i.norm: Verifies that parsing central directory data whose flags byte is 0 results in no timestamp bits being set. The 2-byte buffer is all zeros. We parse with offset=1 and length=1, so the single byte read is buffer[1]=0, which sets the flags to 0 and clears all timestamp-present bits.
A 2-byte all-zero buffer; parsing at offset=1 with length=1 reads one flags byte (0).
Flags byte of 0 means none of the three timestamp bits are set.
